cs.content: Ústní zkouška. Upřesnění podmínek uvádí podrobný sylabus daného akademického roku. Podmínkou je získání zápočtu z praktického laboratorního cvičení. Pro udělení zápočtu je požadována účast na všech cvičeních, vypracování protokolů ze cvičení, dosažení předepsaného počtu bodů (min. 50 %) v průběžných testech. Upřesnění podmínek uvádí podrobný sylabus cvičení daného akademického roku.

en.label: a.

en.content: Molecular structure: chemical bonding, intermolecular bonding, hydrogen bond.

en.content: Bonds in organic molecules. Constitution, isomerism and conformation.
State of matter. (allowance 2/0)

en.label: a.
en.content: Gases: ideal and real gas, gas laws.

en.label: b.
en.content: Liquids: vapour pressure, surface tension, contact angle.

en.label: c.

Energetics and kinetics of chemical reaction (allowance 3/0)

en.label: a.
en.content: Basic terms and definitions.

en.label: b.
en.content: The first thermodynamic theorem and its consequences (thermochemistry).

en.label: c.
en.content: Second thermodynamic theorem and its consequences (entropy).

en.label: d.
en.content: Gibss function.

en.label: e.
en.content: Chemical reaction rate, activation energy; catalysis and inhibition.

en.label: f.
en.content: Chemical equilibrium, Guldberg-Waag law, equilibrium constant.
Dispersion systems and reaction in solution (allowance 5/0)

en.label: a.
en.content: Dispersion systems: General characterization. Henry and Raoult's law. Osmotic pressure. Diffusion.

en.label: b.
en.content: Solutions. Electrolytes, their dissociation

en.label: c.
en.content: Acid-base reactions: acids, bases, their dissociation. pH, calculations of pH value. Isoelectric point. Structure and acid-base properties.

en.label: d.
en.content: Electrochemistry: general terms. Electrode potential, Nernst equation, Nernst-Peterson equation.

en.label: e.
en.content: Complex formation: equilibrium, stability constants. Central ions, ligands.

en.label: f.
en.content: Solubility reactions: solubility products. Formation and properties of precipitation.
Chemical elements and their compounds. (allowance 2/0)

en.label: a.
en.content: Chemical elements occurrence in nature, their biological displaying, chemical behaviour: classifying elements, bonding characterization, important compounds, reaction of chemical elements (compounds). en.label: b.
en.content: Chosen groups and single elements: Hydrogen, water. First vertical column (Na, K). Second vertical column (Mg, Ca). Third vertical group (B, Al). Forth vertical group (C, Si, Pb). Fifth vertical group (N, P, As). Sixth vertical group (O, S, Se). Seventh vertical group (F, Cl, Br, I). Transition elements (Mn, Fe, Cu, Ag, Zn, Cd, Hg, Mo).
Chemistry of organic compounds (allowance 6/0)

en.label: a.
en.content: Organic nomenclature.

en.label: b.
en.content: Mechanism of organic reactions. Induction and mesomer effect. Homolysis and heterolysis. Substrate (substitution, elimination, addition, reverse fault). Reagent (nucleophilic, electrophilic, radical). Oxidation and reduction of organic compounds. Polyreaction.

en.label: c.
en.content: Hydrocarbons: Alkane, cykloalkane, alkene, alkyne. Aromatic hydrocarbons. Polymers.

en.label: d.
en.content: Hydroxy derivates: alcohols, phenols, ethers. Organic compounds containing nitrogen and sulfur. O, N, S heterocyclic compounds.

en.label: e.
en.content: Carbonyl compounds. Aldehydes, ketones and their derivates (hemiacetals).

en.label: f.
en.content: Carboxylic acids: mono-, di- and tricarboxylic acids and their salts.

en.label: g.
en.content: Functional derivatives: amides, esters. Substitution derivatives: hydroxy acids, amino acids, oxo acids. Derivatives of carbon acid. Polycondensates, polyadducts.

en.content: Saccharides: mono-, oligo- and polysaccharides (except wood saccharides). Saccharide reactions. Saccharide derivates.

en.content: Lipids: homo- and heterolipids.

en.label: d.
en.content: Terpenoids.

en.label: e.
en.content: Tannins.

en.content: Introduction, seminar on the safety of work, equipment of laboratory and procedures in laboratory.

en.content: Phenols determination in plant samples.

en.label: f.
en.content: Potenciometric determination of hydrochinone.

en.content: Amino acids reaction, phormol titration.

en.content: Lipids: determination of acid value, saponification value, ester value, iodine value.

en.label: i.
en.content: Tannins determination.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Acquisition of fundamental knowledge of general, inorganic and organic chemistry is necessary for understanding of plant and animal physiology and biochemistry. Structure of course includes acquisition of knowledge of the system, structure and properties of chemical compounds with emphasis on application in wood technology.
